brief: A deep, high-bay warehouse organised as two long racking aisles running toward a concrete end wall. Tall blue-and-orange pallet racking lines both sides, loaded with cardboard cartons, grey plastic totes and shrink-wrapped pallets. A central aisle with worn yellow dashed lane markings stays clear, with floor-stacked pallets of boxes at the edges. At the far end a steel workbench and a smaller shelving bay form a packing/work zone. A tall aluminium ladder leans on the left racking, a black drum fan sits near the foreground, and a hand truck stands by the right racking. Light is cool-neutral and even from industrial high-bay pendants and small skylights, over exposed dark steel trusses and ducting. The mood is utilitarian, busy and orderly.

must_have.where: two long rows of tall blue/orange pallet racking flanking the central aisle
on rack beams and stacked on the floor along the aisle edges
floor-level stacks of cartons and shrink-wrapped pallets beside the aisle
far end of aisle in front of end shelving
end wall, small shelving bay with parts and boxes

concept: A working logistics warehouse where tall colour-coded steel racking, bare concrete and exposed trusses under cool even high-bay light make a functional, load-bearing space with a clear central aisle.
relations: Tall blue/orange racking on both sides creates a corridor that draws the eye to the workbench at the far end wall.
Cool-neutral high-bay pendants plus skylights give even light, which suits the grey concrete floor and wall and the cardboard-brown cargo.
Yellow floor markings and yellow rack guards keep the aisle clear, while pallets and boxes sit at the edges as dense storage.
Exposed dark trusses and ducts raise the ceiling and make the racking feel taller.
Ladder, hand truck and fan are the working tools that show people use the racking.
not_reproducible: Workers, forklifts, the exact carton labels and contents, shrink wrap transparency, floor stains and wear, the skylight glow, the monitor on the far wall and the small parts at the end shelving.
